Case studies

Atlas

A research agent that cites its sources. Reads thousands of pages, plans its own searches and answers with line-level citations.

  • 94.2% citation precision across 12,000 multi-hop enterprise queries.
  • 3.4× faster synthesis pipeline via speculative parallel sub-graph retrieval.
  • Adopted daily by 450+ analysts with zero hallucinated source links.
  • Python
  • LangGraph
  • pgvector

Halcyon

Voice and vision for field technicians. A real-time multimodal assistant that sees the equipment and talks the technician through the fix.

  • 38% reduction in mean time-to-repair across 1,800 field dispatches.
  • Sub-320ms voice-to-voice + frame grounding latency over WebRTC.
  • Hands-free schematic overlay adopted across 14 regional service teams.
  • Whisper
  • Vision LLM
  • WebRTC

Loom

A small model that runs on your phone. A fine-tuned, quantised language model that summarises on-device with no network.

  • 1.8B LoRA-tuned model matching 7B baseline ROUGE-L within 1.2 points.
  • 48 tokens/sec sustained on mobile NPU with 4-bit GGUF quantization.
  • Under 1.1 GB peak RAM footprint and <2% battery draw per 50 summaries.
  • PyTorch
  • LoRA
  • GGUF

Meridian

Evals that catch regressions first. A test harness that scores every prompt and model change before it reaches users.

  • Caught 97% of prompt & tool-call regressions in CI prior to staging.
  • 14,000+ golden traces evaluated automatically in under 90 seconds.
  • Saved ~11 engineering hours per release cycle across 6 product squads.
  • TypeScript
  • Postgres
